editions.title: Let It Be

editions.title: Corrugated Dreams & Other Inflated Expectations

editions.catalog: Impermanence, creativity, and the joy of making things.

editions.title: Grateful Dogs
editions.teaser: He made that sound exactly once. The moment we untied him from that bellhop cart, it was gone. He never needed it again. He knew exactly what he was doing.
editions.catalog: Rescue, kismet, and Kauai — part one of a trilogy.

editions.title: Happy Little Accidents
editions.catalog: Blank canvases, happy accidents, and building in public.
editions.cardOnlyNote: The narrative for this edition lives on LinkedIn — the visual card is preserved here in full.

editions.title: Burgers and Dogs
editions.teaser: I told myself it was recon — a look, nothing more, with a cheeseburger waiting on the other end of the drive regardless. Then a worker walked into the waiting room with a dog in each hand, and recon was over. Part 2 of the Grateful Dogs trilogy.
editions.catalog: Grateful Dogs part two — getting waylaid for the better.

editions.title: Dupree's Diamond Blondes
editions.teaser: We'd been trying for a baby for a while. It wasn't working. So we did the audacious thing — we dared the universe to give us one anyway, and got a dog instead. Part 3, the finale, of the Grateful Dogs trilogy.
editions.catalog: The Grateful Dogs finale — daring fate in Alabama.

editions.title: Two Sleeping Giants
editions.teaser: An icebreaker where nobody says their name. A mountain that followed me five thousand miles across an ocean. And the day Hawaii became a state — sixty-seven years ago today.
editions.catalog: Hawaii Statehood Day, belonging, and two mountains with the same name.

editions.title: Safe at Home
editions.teaser: I was eight years old the summer a team from down the road beat the world. Thirty-seven years later I still put the games on — and Nietzsche, of all people, finally explained why.
editions.catalog: The Little League World Series, the end of summer, and why Nietzsche put the child last.
